title: What if Earth lost all its air in one second? 🌍
subject: atmosphere
description:
Which change would hit you first? 👇

What would happen if Earth's atmosphere disappeared? The sky goes black at noon, lakes boil and freeze at once, and the planet cools toward Moon-like extremes.

Sources: NASA Science, "Weather on the Moon"; NASA Climate / NASA Earth Observatory (greenhouse effect, Earth at about -18°C without heat-trapping gases); NASA Space Place, "Why is the sky blue?"; Harvard Natural Sciences Lecture Demonstrations, "Boiling/Freezing of Water in a Vacuum"
tags: what if earth lost its atmosphere
what if earth had no air

scenes.text: Without air, you'd see stars at noon.
With nothing to scatter sunlight into blue, the sky turns black, like on the Moon.
Sound stops. Outside, you'd pass out in about 15 seconds.
Lakes start to boil at room temperature. Harvard physicists show it in a jar: pump out the air, and water boils, then freezes.
Without heat-trapping gases, NASA puts Earth near minus 18°C. Moon nights hit minus 133°C.
All of it depends on that thin blue line.
